scope: Graphic water crops only; scan numbers are distinct from printed-page numbers.

groups.name: Currents and waterlines
groups.description: Long meanders, flowing parallel lines, drifting pools and gently layered swells.
groups.construction: Shared-displacement bands; cubic or harmonic centerlines; related contour families.

groups.name: Crests and breakers
groups.description: Overturning hooks, curling tips, upright breaking waves and layered wave fronts.
groups.construction: Parametric crest paths with a return curl; nested contours and optional foam.

groups.name: Eddies, scrolls and spirals
groups.description: Coiled currents, opposing scrolls, whirlpools and spiral medallions.
groups.construction: Spiral segments joined to flow paths; paired handedness and unequal curl radii.

groups.name: Ripples, scallops and nested arcs
groups.description: Repeated arc bundles, ripple rings, scales and small rounded swells.
groups.construction: Nested arcs and partial rings; staggered repeats with explicit open and closed forms.

groups.name: Foam, spray, droplets and cells
groups.description: Detached water marks, dotted spray, bead chains, bubbly rims and cellular water textures.
groups.construction: Sparse secondary marks following a parent crest; bounded point and small-loop motifs.

groups.name: Braids, lattices and herringbone
groups.description: Interlaced current ribbons, diagonal blocks, linked bands and geometric repeats.
groups.construction: Two related line directions or a crossing graph; preserve intended over-under order.

groups.name: Fans, fountains and feathered jets
groups.description: Splayed line bundles, upward jets and bilateral feather-like water forms.
groups.construction: Diverging paths from an attachment region; bounded branching and a tip envelope.
